message: あこがれのπ

name: Nanaka
message: 「Things sure turned into a huge mess, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do you think we can win?」
We probably won't win unless I become a full-fledged Demon Lord.

name: Synn
message: 「We'll win.」
We will win.
If we don't, I'm sure our words will never reach Azel.
Even if that ends up revealing to Nanaka that I'm the Demon Lord.

name: Synn
message: 「After all, we're going to make the Holy Night Festival a success.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Yeah, you're right.」
Once the Holy Night Festival comes around, I'm sure Nanaka will talk to me.
And when she does, I'll tell Nanaka too.

name: Nanaka
message: 「We have to make it a success, don't we?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」
About what's been weighing so heavily on Nanaka's mind
What's always been on my mind, more than anyone else's
Though, those feelings might just change our relationship as childhood friends
Still, I'll tell her.

name: Nanaka
message: 「...What Melilot said back there. Don't you think she was talking about me?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I can't even use my Guardian Angel powers sometimes... not always, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「You're wrong. I'm sure of it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How can you say something like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're wrong. Definitely wrong. I just have a feeling.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'Definitely,' when it's just some vague feeling? That makes no sense.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then definitely.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But you know, Melilot-san... she still had us practice as if someone might drop out」

name: Synn
message: 「Even without what happened with you, Nanaka, she would've done that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You... think so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Definitely」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No 'well then,' no 'I feel like,' just 'definitely'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you say so, Synn, then I'll just go with that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here is fine」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll walk you all the way to Yuugiri-an」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I said it's fine, it's not like I'm a little kid」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm walking you. Besides, it's been a while since we walked home together like this」
I want to be with her even a little longer. Am I weird for thinking something like that?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha. This kinda feels like we're lovers who can't bear to part」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm joking!　Just joking!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I know that」
Ah, my heart is pounding.
Surely, probably, that's what this is.
I can't stand just being Nanaka's childhood friend anymore.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh... hey?」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn, do you...」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ever feel dissatisfied with yourself?　Like wanting to become someone else」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Not really. I actually like myself pretty well」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Narcissist」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think it's quite like that, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「How should I put it--the me right now is the only me there is, or rather, I can only do what I'm capable of, so I don't want to use that as an excuse」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I like how seriously you try to answer stuff like that」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right...」
Just hearing the word "like" come out of Nanaka's mouth makes my heart skip a beat.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've... thought about wanting to be someone else before」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, really?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A cool girl who can say whatever's on her mind without holding back」

name: Synn
message: 「You're already like that, Nanaka. You always say whatever's on your mind」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, I don't」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I can't say the things I actually want to say」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though I sure do talk a lot about stuff that doesn't matter」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
There are probably so many things I haven't noticed.
Probably up until now, and from here on out too.
Even so, I.

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me wants to become Ria-chan's boobs!」
